x: Although a foot below his best for the season, John Mitchell finished 4th in the Long jump with 22'-2¾". Martin (22.9) was unlucky to be eliminated in a 220 heat with such a good time, as was Gleeson (51.3) in the 440.

The combination of these two plus Gleeson and Oliver was far too strong for any other team the South of England could put up. They recorded the same time in the heat and final,winning by a full ten yards - an excellent performance.
Thanks partly to fine efforts by Martin in the sprints and Gleeson in the quarter our lads were able to chalk up yet another win. This time they took home the "Kirkbride" Trophy.
